description: A report of documented behaviour as a bug: the right outcome is no code change and an answer that says where the docs describe it
prompt:
Bug: `@file` includes don't work in the middle of a prompt. With a program like

```
run @notes.md and summarise it
```

nb sends the literal text `@notes.md and summarise it` to the model; the file is never included. `run @notes.md` on its own line works fine, so the include code is clearly there. Can you fix this?
